root.description: The id of the root the path is under

path.description: The package.json the condition is about, relative to its root

code.description: `WORKSPACE_MEMBER_NO_ROWS`: a member's package.json has no rows this run, so its name, version and dependencies are unknown; `WORKSPACE_TARGET_UNKNOWN`: a dependency the manager would link by name matches no member with rows while some member's name is unknown, so it may link that member; `WORKSPACE_CATALOG_UNRESOLVED`: a `catalog:` range names no entry of pnpm-workspace.yaml's catalogs

seq.description: 0-based position among the path's conditions of this code

projection-workspace-conditions.description: A row of the derived `workspace_conditions` relation
